nary_nodes.label: Jewelry theft at Lalique museum
evidence: Burglars stole millions of dollars worth of jewelry from the museum of French luxury glassmaker Lalique in a daring early-morning raid on Sunday, just months after a stunning gem heist at the Louvre in Paris.

A gang of masked thieves broke in to the museum in Wingen-sur-Moder in northeastern France around 5:30 am, forcing a door before heading for the jewelry room and smashing open six display cases, a source close to the investigation told AFP.

nary_nodes.label: Louvre museum heist
evidence: Thieves made off with $102 million worth of jewelry, including some of the old French crown jewels, from the Louvre in a raid lasting less than eight minutes.

nary_nodes.label: Natural History Museum gold theft
evidence: Last October, a woman was arrested and charged over the theft of gold from the Natural History Museum in Paris.

nary_nodes.label: Adrien Dubouche National Museum porcelain heist
evidence: In September, thieves snatched three porcelain works worth millions of dollars and classed as national treasures in a heist at the Adrien Dubouche National Museum in Limoges in central France.

nary_nodes.label: Cognacq-Jay museum 18th-century works heist
evidence: four men with axes and baseball bats smashed the display cases in broad daylight at the Cognacq-Jay museum in Paris, making off with several 18th-century works.

nary_nodes.label: Stolen jewelry valued at several million euros
evidence: "Around twenty pieces of jewelry were stolen. The loss is currently being assessed but could amount to several million euros, likely close to four million (over $4.5 million)," the source said.

nary_nodes.label: Security company failed to respond promptly
evidence: "An alarm went off, but by the time the security company had completed its checks, it was a cleaning lady who arrived first on the scene and called the police," the first investigation source added.

nary_nodes.label: 35% of Louvre rooms not monitored
evidence: A security audit found that 35% of the rooms in the Denon Wing, where the stolen jewels were displayed, were not monitored by security cameras, according to Radio France.

nary_nodes.label: Gems not privately insured per French law
evidence: The gems were also not privately insured, in accordance with French law.

nary_nodes.label: Suspected Louvre thieves arrested
evidence: The suspected thieves have been arrested and charged, but none of the jewels have been recovered except for a crown that was dropped as the group escaped.

nary_nodes.label: Museum will be closed for several days
evidence: The museum said on its website that it will be closed for several day because of the burglary.
